khm.text: Starnheim is the radiant realm Niko Aris reaches through an Omenpath, arriving at its docks and feeling that they are home, before joining the feasting dead.
Niko warns the Valkyries that the Cosmos Serpent is coming, and they refuse to believe Starnheim can be attacked, until Tibalt uses the Sword of the Realms to unleash Koma on them.

Niko proposes luring Koma like a cat chasing toys back out through an Omenpath, and with the Valkyries baiting it and mirror traps hiding their bodies, Koma crashes through the hole and falls out of Starnheim.
Elsewhere in the realm, Njala seeks out the skald Hormgart to learn how Arni earned his name.
